assessments.reasoning: The same-type actual variable access establishes a reference before block activation. The formal denotes that variable throughout. The continuation excludes a variant selector field and a component of a variable of packed type.

challenge.method: Read the full clause across printed pp.35–36 and check whether the restriction is on a component of a packed variable or on any variable whose value involves packing.
challenge.results: The exclusion is the selector field and the designated packed variable’s component. This is narrower than excluding a whole variable of packed type. Alias freedom and the ordinary versus conformant-array boundary are left open.

limitations: This gives binding and eligibility, not an ABI, unconditional alias-freedom guarantee, or conformant-array parameter treatment.
Exact unextended ISO/IEC 7185:1990 online replica. The replica gives the printed text precedence where they differ. ISO 10206 Extended Pascal and product dialects require separate evidence.
